blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—No bettor won the ₱377.06 million Ultra Lotto 6/58 jackpot or the ₱101.03 million Mega Lotto 6/45 jackpot in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) draws Friday, Oct. 9, 2026. The Ultra Lotto 6/58 draw produced the winning combination 29-38-33-14-02-30, with a jackpot prize of ₱377.06 million. No ticket matched all six numbers. The Mega Lotto 6/45 draw yielded the winning combination 30-24-32-26-35-25, carrying a jackpot of ₱101.03 million. No bettor won the top prize.
